title: TremoloEffect
description: Tremolo effect that amplitude-modulates the signal with a sine LFO using native WebAudio nodes. A sine-wave LFO drives a `GainNode`'s gain to produce the characteristic volume pulsing of tremolo. The base gain is `1 - depth / 2` and the LFO peak deviation is `depth / 2`, so the gain oscillates between `1 - depth` and `1`. Optionally the same LFO can drive a `StereoPannerNode.pan` for a synchronized auto-pan effect. Node graph (`autoPan = false`): ``` inputGain ┬── dryGain ──────────────────────────┐ │ ├── outputGain └── tremoloGain ── wetGain ─────────────┘ lfoOscillator ── lfoGain (depth / 2) ── tremoloGain.gain ``` Node graph (`autoPan = true`): ``` inputGain ┬── dryGain ──────────────────────────────────┐ │ ├── outputGain └── tremoloGain ── panner ── wetGain ──────────┘ lfoOscillator ── lfoGain (depth / 2) ── tremoloGain.gain lfoOscillator ── panGain (depth) ── panner.pan ``` Gains: `dryGain.gain = 1 - wet`; `wetGain.gain = wet`; `tremoloGain.gain` base = `1 - depth / 2`.

members.name: _deferSetup
members.description: Run setup with the shared AudioContext: immediately when it is ready, otherwise once it unlocks. setup must create the nodes behind inputNode and outputNode; the effect counts as wired as soon as it returns. Returning a promise defers ready until it settles, and a rejection or a synchronous throw makes ready reject with that error. Call it at the end of the subclass constructor, after the fields setup reads are initialized - from a base constructor it could run before them. A subclass's destroy() calls AudioEffect._teardown.

members.name: _teardown
members.description: Marks the effect unwired and drops a setup still waiting for the AudioContext, so a destroyed effect is never wired again and never builds its nodes late. An effect not yet ready rejects ready with an AbortError; a setup still in flight can no longer resolve it.

members.name: destroy
members.description: Disconnects all audio nodes and releases resources. Must be called when the effect is no longer needed.

members.name: autoPan
members.description: Whether auto-pan is enabled. Set at construction time via TremoloEffectOptions.autoPan; read-only at runtime. Default false.

members.name: depth
members.description: Modulation depth, 0..1: the gain swings between 1 - depth and 1, so 0 is transparent and 1 reaches silence at the trough. Default 0.7. Ramped via setTargetAtTime.

members.name: inputNode
members.description: The node where audio enters this effect. Throws if the audio context is not yet initialized.

members.name: outputNode
members.description: The node where audio exits this effect. Throws if the audio context is not yet initialized.

members.name: rateHz
members.description: LFO oscillation rate in Hz. Range 0..20, default 5. Ramped via setTargetAtTime when changed at runtime.

members.name: ready
members.description: Resolves once the effect is fully initialized: its nodes exist and, for an effect with asynchronous setup such as a worklet effect, that setup has completed. Stays pending while the shared AudioContext is locked. Rejects with the setup's error when the setup fails (a worklet effect whose module cannot load keeps passing audio through dry, but is not ready), and with an AbortError when the effect is destroyed before it became ready.

members.name: wet
members.description: Wet (tremolo) mix level, 0..1. The dry level is automatically 1 - wet. Default 1. Ramped via setTargetAtTime when changed at runtime.
